expected: T004 F02-AC-014 requires rejected candidate bodies to never become executable durable artifacts. admitBlueprint must admit only one stable validator-issued PASSED snapshot whose report/admissible pair cannot change between provenance verification and repository persistence.
actual: Post-closure exhaustive audit found a TOCTOU admission bypass in the merged T004 implementation. admitBlueprint reads caller-owned result.admissible/result.report multiple times. A getter/Proxy can return a genuine sealed PASSED report+admissible pair for isSealedPassedResult(), then return a forged PASSED report plus rejected-body admissible object on later reads. The repository then sees run.status=PASSED and run.blueprint_hash matching the forged content_hash and can persist a body that was never validator-issued. Deep-freezing the genuine sealed pair does not stop the outer result object from changing which pair it returns. Final same-class audit additionally found that sealPassedResult itself is exported from admissible-provenance.ts. Any in-repo caller can construct an arbitrary PASSED report plus arbitrary AdmissibleBlueprint, invoke the exported sealer, and enroll that forged pair into the WeakMap accepted by admitBlueprint. The provenance mechanism therefore does not currently reserve issuance authority to validateBlueprintCandidate.

Deterministic exploit order: admissible getter read #1 -> genuine sealed admissible; report getter #1 + admissible getter #2 -> genuine sealed pair passes WeakMap provenance; report getter #2 -> forged PASSED report; admissible getter #3 -> forged rejected-body content.
